events.title: Gas storage drains
events.desc: European gas inventories abnormally low at the start of the heating season.
events.headline: EU gas stocks hit 10-year low for August
events.mix_impact: First nudge: utilities lean on coal to spare gas storage.

events.title: Gas prices triple
events.desc: TTF gas hits €100/MWh as Russia keeps supply tight ahead of winter.
events.headline: European gas hits record €100/MWh
events.mix_impact: Coal share rises sharply across Germany, Poland, Czechia.

events.title: Troops mass at border
events.desc: 100k Russian troops mass at the Ukrainian border; markets begin pricing in war risk.
events.headline: NATO warns of imminent Russian build-up
events.mix_impact: Gas-fired generation eases as utilities pre-buy and switch fuels.

events.title: Invasion begins
events.desc: Russia invades Ukraine on Feb 24. Energy markets enter panic mode.
events.headline: Russia launches full-scale invasion of Ukraine
events.mix_impact: Across the EU mix: gas plunges, coal jumps, nuclear runs flat-out.

events.title: Sanctions cascade
events.desc: EU/US impose sweeping sanctions on Russian banks. Brent tops $130/bbl.
events.headline: Brent surges above $130 on Russia ban fears
events.mix_impact: Coal share climbs further; renewables capped by capacity not demand.

events.title: REPowerEU plan
events.desc: Commission unveils €300bn plan to wean Europe off Russian fossil fuels by 2027.
events.headline: REPowerEU plan unveiled
events.mix_impact: Long-term policy floor under solar + wind investment.

events.title: Nord Stream slashed
events.desc: Gazprom cuts Nord Stream 1 flows to 40% then 20% of capacity.
events.headline: Gazprom slashes Nord Stream flows
events.mix_impact: Gas share collapses; lignite plants restart in Germany.

events.title: Heatwave compounds
events.desc: Record heatwave forces French nuclear curtailments — supply tightens further.
events.headline: EDF cuts nuclear output as rivers warm
events.mix_impact: France's nuclear share drops from 70% to ~50% on cooling-water limits.

events.title: Peak prices
events.desc: Day-ahead electricity peaks above €700/MWh in many EU markets.
events.headline: European power smashes records, France above €1,000
events.mix_impact: Mix can't move further: every flexible MWh is already dispatched.

events.title: Nord Stream sabotage
events.desc: Pipeline ruptures end any return to pre-war Russian gas via the Baltic.
events.headline: Nord Stream pipelines hit by sabotage
events.mix_impact: Pipeline gas option permanently removed from the mix.

events.title: EU price cap debate
events.desc: Member states wrangle over an EU-wide gas price cap mechanism.
events.headline: EU split on emergency gas price cap
events.mix_impact: Hedging behaviour shifts; spot volatility eases slightly.

events.title: Mild winter saves the day
events.desc: Unusually warm December plus 15% demand cut break the price spiral.
events.headline: Warm winter saves Europe from blackouts
events.mix_impact: Less gas burn than feared; storage still 80%+ end of January.

events.title: Prices ease
events.desc: Mild winter and demand cuts pull day-ahead below €200/MWh.
events.headline: European power dives back to pre-war levels
events.mix_impact: Coal share starts retreating; renewables hit new monthly records.

events.title: Germany ends nuclear
events.desc: Last three nuclear plants close, leaving Germany more gas-dependent at the margin.
events.headline: Germany shuts down its last nuclear reactors
events.mix_impact: Germany's nuclear share goes to zero; gas + renewables fill in.

events.title: First post-war winter normal
events.desc: Europe makes it through a second winter without Russian gas. Storage 90%+.
events.headline: Europe ends winter with gas storage full
events.mix_impact: Coal share now below pre-crisis levels in most countries.

events.title: New baseline
events.desc: Prices stabilise around €70-90/MWh — still well above the 2018-2020 norm.
events.headline: Power finds new normal at €80/MWh
events.mix_impact: Wind + solar combine for >30% of EU annual generation for the first time.

events.title: Russian transit ends
events.desc: Ukraine refuses to renew the Russian gas transit deal expiring Dec 31.
events.headline: Kyiv rules out gas transit deal renewal
events.mix_impact: Last pipeline link from Russia disappears from the supply mix.

events.title: Transit halts
events.desc: Last Russian pipeline gas through Ukraine stops on New Year's Day.
events.headline: Russian gas to Europe via Ukraine ends
events.mix_impact: Eastern EU's gas mix re-routes via LNG and Trans-Balkan pipeline.

events.title: Renewables top fossils
events.desc: EU renewables outpace fossil fuels in the power mix for the first time on an annual basis.
events.headline: Renewables overtake fossils in EU power mix
events.mix_impact: Structural mix tilt: solar adds ~50 GW in a single year.

events.title: Storage strain returns
events.desc: Low wind + slow refilling push prices back toward €120/MWh in Q3.
events.headline: Europe's gas storage refill stutters
events.mix_impact: Gas burn rises again briefly; coal use stays low.

events.title: Cool winter, calm markets
events.desc: Warmer-than-average February keeps prices contained despite ongoing war.
events.headline: Warm February eases European power demand
events.mix_impact: Renewables share peaks above 50% for the month in several countries.

events.title: Today
events.desc: Day-ahead prices are still ~2× the 2018-2020 baseline three years after the war began.
events.headline: Europe's electricity bill: the war's longest scar
events.mix_impact: The mix has structurally tilted toward renewables — but at a price.

events.title: Tit-for-tat strikes
events.desc: Iran-backed proxies attack US bases; Houthi Red Sea attacks reroute LNG cargoes.
events.headline: Red Sea LNG diversions add to gas costs
events.mix_impact: LNG cargoes detour around Africa, adding 2–3 weeks transit.

events.title: Direct strikes
events.desc: Iran and Israel exchange direct missile strikes for the first time. Brent jumps to $90.
events.headline: Iran launches direct strike on Israel
events.mix_impact: Brief oil-driven uptick in fossil generation; renewables quickly absorb.

events.title: Oil markets jittery
events.desc: Assassination of Hamas leader in Tehran sparks fresh escalation fears.
events.headline: Brent crude jumps on Tehran assassination
events.mix_impact: Gas peakers cycle harder on heatwave + risk premium.

events.title: Strait of Hormuz risk
events.desc: Iran threats around the Strait lift LNG and oil benchmarks; ~20% of world LNG passes here.
events.headline: Hormuz tensions rattle global LNG
events.mix_impact: Europe still well-supplied — almost no observable shift in the mix.

events.title: Sanctions tighten
events.desc: New US sanctions package targets Iranian crude exports to China.
events.headline: Fresh US sanctions hit Iran oil exports
events.mix_impact: Indirect: cheaper Iranian crude into China shifts global flows.

events.title: Tanker incidents
events.desc: Three commercial tankers damaged in the Gulf; insurance premiums spike.
events.headline: Gulf insurance rates soar
events.mix_impact: Marginal LNG cargo costs rise; ~€2/MWh gas premium in EU.

events.title: Diplomatic stalemate
events.desc: Nuclear talks in Vienna collapse; markets price in long-term Middle East risk.
events.headline: Iran nuclear talks break down
events.mix_impact: Long-term LNG contracts re-priced; minimal mix impact short-term.

events.title: Power-price echo
events.desc: European day-ahead prices nudge higher despite ample storage — a softer echo of 2022.
events.headline: European power feels Middle East ripple
events.mix_impact: Gas share inches up; coal use flat — buffers held.

events.title: Year-end calm
events.desc: Markets price in a contained shock; prices remain near recent norms.
events.headline: 2025 ends with energy markets steady
events.mix_impact: Renewables continue to gain share — mix tilt independent of crisis.

events.title: Cyber-attack on grid
events.desc: Iran-linked cyber actors target a European TSO; brief but no outage.
events.headline: EU cyber agency raises grid alert
events.mix_impact: No mix impact; reliability concerns drive battery investment.

events.title: Drone strike on refinery
events.desc: A Gulf refinery hit by drones; diesel cracks widen.
events.headline: Refinery strike lifts diesel premiums
events.mix_impact: Oil-fired backup generation slightly more expensive at the margin.

events.title: Today
events.desc: Tensions persist but Europe's gas diversification absorbs most of the shock.
events.headline: Iran risk lingers but Europe has built buffers
events.mix_impact: Renewables + storage now structurally dampen geopolitical shocks.
